name: ContestCog
author: Ruffiana
short: Interactive dashboard cog for Unicornia's Cutie of the Month Contest
description: This cog posts an interactive Components V2 dashboard with contest information, terms, prizes, and voting instructions, and counts reactions to distribute rewards.
install_msg: Thank you for installing the Unicornia Cutie of the Month Contest Cog!
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the user IDs, names and vote counts of paid contest places, so rewards are paid once to the same winners. Red data-deletion requests remove the user from saved results.
